jobs.title: Director of Convening
jobs.reason: While the candidate's academic background in international relations, international law, and policy research aligns perfectly with Chatham House's mission, the role requires significant leadership and high-level event management experience which the candidate currently lacks. The candidate's experience is primarily at a student assistant level, making this Director-level position far too senior.

jobs.title: Senior Research Analyst - Research and Innovation Policy (Evaluation)
jobs.reason: While the candidate demonstrates strong alignment in higher education policy research and possesses relevant research, data analysis, and policy writing skills, the "Senior Research Analyst" title indicates a requirement for significant professional experience (typically 5+ years) that the candidate, with only student assistant roles, does not yet meet. This seniority mismatch is the primary reason for the low rating.

jobs.title: Public Affairs and Communications Executive
jobs.reason: This role is an excellent match for the candidate. Their extensive research, data analysis, and policy writing experience from academic assistant roles and publications directly align with the job's core duties. The "junior recruit" and "introductory experience" requirements are perfectly met by the candidate's MSc in progress and relevant student assistant positions. While the candidate's academic focus is on international relations and critical theory, the role's generalist nature and emphasis on learning new policy areas make their broad analytical background a strong asset. The primary practical consideration is the May 2026 start date, which may precede the completion of their MSc.
